examples.en: This recipe is easy to follow.
examples.zh: 这个食谱很容易照着做。

examples.en: Grandma taught me her cake recipe.
examples.zh: 奶奶教了我她的蛋糕食谱。

mnemonic.tip: re(再)+cipe，想成"照着单子再做一次"就是食谱。

examples.en: Eating vegetables keeps you healthy.
We grow vegetables in our garden.

mnemonic.tip: veg 像"菜地"，table 是桌子，菜地到餐桌就是蔬菜。

examples.en: The soup smells delicious.
What a delicious meal!

mnemonic.tip: 记 de-licious 像"的确好吃"，一尝就知道美味。

examples.en: I have breakfast at seven.
Breakfast is the most important meal.

mnemonic.tip: break(打破)+fast(禁食)，一夜没吃打破空腹就是早餐。

examples.en: Let's eat at a Chinese restaurant.
This restaurant is always full.

mnemonic.tip: rest(休息)+aurant，累了进去休息吃饭的地方。

examples.en: Can I see the menu, please?
examples.zh: 请给我看一下菜单好吗？

examples.en: There are many dishes on the menu.

mnemonic.tip: 谐音"没牛"——看看菜单上有没有牛肉。

examples.en: Ice cream is my favourite dessert.
examples.zh: 冰淇淋是我最爱的甜点。

examples.en: We had cake for dessert.

mnemonic.tip: 比 desert(沙漠) 多一个 s，甜点甜到要两份 s(sweet sweet)。

examples.en: This drink has a strawberry flavour.
I like the flavour of fresh mint.
examples.zh: 我喜欢新鲜薄荷的味道。

mnemonic.tip: fla-vour 联想"发味儿"，散发出来的味道。

examples.en: I need a snack before dinner.
Fruit makes a healthy snack.

mnemonic.tip: snack 像 snap(随手一拿)——随手拿一口吃的就是零食。

examples.en: Boil the water before you cook.
She boiled two eggs for lunch.
examples.zh: 她煮了两个鸡蛋当午饭。

mnemonic.tip: boil 像"波一路"(bo+il)翻滚——水滚起来就是沸腾。

examples.en: Fry the onions until they are soft.
He fried an egg for breakfast.

mnemonic.tip: french fries(薯条)就是炸出来的，fry 就是炸。

examples.en: Taste the soup and tell me.
The cake tastes sweet.

mnemonic.tip: taste 里有 't-a-s-te'，尝一口"它(ta)"什么味。

examples.en: We enjoy a big meal on Sundays.
examples.zh: 周日我们会享用一顿大餐。

examples.en: Dinner is my favourite meal.

mnemonic.tip: meal 和 eat 都有 'ea' 音，一顿要吃(eat)的饭。

examples.en: I bought some fresh bread.
Fresh fruit is good for you.

mnemonic.tip: 谐音"腐来吸"反着想，fresh 就是没腐坏、新鲜。

examples.en: Do you take sugar in your tea?
Too much sugar is bad for teeth.

mnemonic.tip: sugar 读音像"许ger"，甜得让人忍不住许个愿。

examples.en: Put the food on a clean plate.
examples.zh: 把食物放在干净的盘子上。

examples.en: She washed all the plates.

mnemonic.tip: plate 和 flat(平的) 音近，盘子是平的。

examples.en: I'd like to order a pizza.
Are you ready to order?

mnemonic.tip: 在餐厅按"顺序(order)"报菜名，就是点餐。

examples.en: A healthy diet has lots of vegetables.
examples.zh: 健康饮食含有大量蔬菜。

examples.en: Running keeps me healthy.

mnemonic.tip: health(健康)+y，形容词就是健康的。

examples.en: Black coffee tastes bitter.
The medicine was very bitter.

mnemonic.tip: bitter 像"逼特"——苦得让人直皱眉。

examples.en: I love spicy noodles.
This curry is too spicy for me.
examples.zh: 这咖喱对我来说太辣了。

mnemonic.tip: spice(香料/辣料)+y，加了辣料就是 spicy。

examples.en: The bakery sells warm bread.
examples.zh: 这家面包店卖热乎乎的面包。

examples.en: I smell cake from the bakery.
examples.zh: 我闻到面包店飘来的蛋糕香。

mnemonic.tip: bake(烘烤)+ry(地方)，烘烤的地方就是面包店。

examples.en: A balanced diet is important.
She is on a diet this month.

mnemonic.tip: 谐音"呆挨特"，节食时呆呆地挨饿。

examples.en: I'm thirsty; can I have some water?
Running makes me thirsty.

mnemonic.tip: thirst(口渴)+y，形容词就是口渴的。

examples.en: They serve lunch at noon.
The waiter served us quickly.
examples.zh: 服务员很快给我们上了菜。

mnemonic.tip: service(服务)的动词，上菜也是一种 serve。

examples.en: Flour is the main ingredient in bread.
examples.zh: 面粉是面包的主要原料。

examples.en: Mix all the ingredients together.
examples.zh: 把所有配料混合在一起。

mnemonic.tip: in-gre-dient 联想"进锅点"，进锅的每一点都是配料。

examples.en: The beef was cooked with onions and potatoes.
examples.zh: 牛肉是和洋葱、土豆一起炖的。

examples.en: I don't eat much beef because it's expensive.

mnemonic.tip: beef 牛肉、pork 猪肉、lamb 羊肉——肉类三兄弟一起记。

examples.en: Pork is the most common meat in Chinese cooking.
examples.zh: 猪肉是中餐里最常用的肉。

examples.en: She bought some pork to make dumplings.

mnemonic.tip: pig 是活猪，端上桌就改叫 pork——英语里牲畜和肉常用不同词。

examples.en: We had roast lamb for dinner last night.
The lamb was following its mother across the field.
examples.zh: 小羊跟着妈妈穿过田野。

mnemonic.tip: lamb 里的 b 不发音；小羊和羊肉都是 lamb。

examples.en: He ordered a steak with chips at the restaurant.
examples.zh: 他在餐厅点了牛排配薯条。

examples.en: How would you like your steak cooked?

mnemonic.tip: steak 与 stake(木桩)同音——一大块像木板的肉就是牛排。

examples.en: She fried some bacon and eggs for breakfast.
examples.zh: 她煎了培根和鸡蛋当早餐。

examples.en: The smell of bacon woke everyone up.
examples.zh: 培根的香味把大家都弄醒了。

mnemonic.tip: bacon 谐音"培根"——本身就是音译词。

examples.en: We grilled sausages at the barbecue.
examples.zh: 我们在烧烤会上烤了香肠。

examples.en: This sausage is made from pork and herbs.
examples.zh: 这种香肠是用猪肉和香草做的。

mnemonic.tip: sau 音近"馊"——香肠放久会馊，要放冰箱。

examples.en: People eat turkey at Christmas in Britain.
The turkey was too big for our small oven.
examples.zh: 火鸡太大，我们的小烤箱装不下。

mnemonic.tip: 大写 Turkey 是土耳其，小写 turkey 是火鸡——传说因商路经过土耳其得名。

examples.en: Beijing roast duck is famous all over the world.
The ducks were swimming on the lake.

mnemonic.tip: 动物和肉同词：duck 既是鸭子也是鸭肉。

examples.en: Salmon is rich in healthy oils.
examples.zh: 三文鱼富含健康的鱼油。

examples.en: She had grilled salmon with vegetables for lunch.
examples.zh: 她午餐吃了烤三文鱼配蔬菜。

mnemonic.tip: salmon 的 l 不发音，读 /ˈsæmən/——三文鱼是它的音译。

examples.en: I made a tuna sandwich for the picnic.
examples.zh: 我做了金枪鱼三明治去野餐。

examples.en: Tinned tuna is cheap and full of protein.
examples.zh: 金枪鱼罐头便宜又富含蛋白质。

mnemonic.tip: tuna 谐音"吞拿"——港式茶餐厅的吞拿鱼就是它。

examples.en: This coastal town is famous for its fresh seafood.
examples.zh: 这座海滨小镇以新鲜海鲜闻名。

examples.en: He can't eat seafood because he is allergic to it.

mnemonic.tip: sea(海)+food(食物)→海里来的食物→海鲜。

examples.en: Wild mushrooms can be dangerous to eat.
examples.zh: 野蘑菇吃了可能有危险。

examples.en: She added mushrooms to the soup.

mnemonic.tip: mush+room：长在潮湿"房间"角落里的小伞——蘑菇。

examples.en: Cutting onions always makes me cry.
Fry the onions until they turn golden.

mnemonic.tip: onion 一层包一层——union(联合)的近亲，层层"联合"成洋葱。

examples.en: She sliced a cucumber for the salad.
Cucumbers are mostly made of water.

mnemonic.tip: as cool as a cucumber 冷静如黄瓜——英语用黄瓜形容淡定。

examples.en: Wash the lettuce before you put it in the salad.
examples.zh: 把生菜洗干净再放进沙拉。

examples.en: The burger comes with lettuce and tomato.
examples.zh: 这个汉堡配生菜和番茄。

mnemonic.tip: lettuce 谐音"来吐司"——生菜夹吐司，经典三明治。

examples.en: Spinach is full of iron and vitamins.
Popeye becomes strong after eating spinach.
examples.zh: 大力水手吃了菠菜就变强壮。

mnemonic.tip: 大力水手 Popeye 的能量罐头装的就是 spinach。

examples.en: We made a lantern out of a big pumpkin.
examples.zh: 我们用大南瓜做了一盏灯。

examples.en: Pumpkin soup is popular in autumn.
examples.zh: 南瓜汤在秋天很受欢迎。

mnemonic.tip: 万圣节 Halloween 的主角灯笼就是 pumpkin 刻的。

examples.en: The corn in the fields is ready to pick.
We ate sweet corn at the barbecue.
examples.zh: 我们在烧烤会上吃了甜玉米。

mnemonic.tip: popcorn(爆米花) = pop(爆)+corn(玉米)。

examples.en: Beans are a cheap source of protein.
examples.zh: 豆类是便宜的蛋白质来源。

examples.en: She planted some beans in the garden.
examples.zh: 她在园子里种了些豆子。

mnemonic.tip: 杰克的魔豆 magic beans 一夜长上天。

examples.en: Nuts make a healthy snack between meals.
examples.zh: 坚果是两餐之间的健康零食。

examples.en: This cake contains nuts, so be careful if you are allergic.
examples.zh: 这个蛋糕含坚果，过敏的话要小心。

mnemonic.tip: doughnut(甜甜圈)里藏着 nut；坚果有硬壳。

examples.en: He spread peanut butter on his toast.
examples.zh: 他在吐司上抹了花生酱。

examples.en: Some children are seriously allergic to peanuts.
examples.zh: 有些孩子对花生严重过敏。

mnemonic.tip: pea(豌豆)+nut(坚果)→长得像豆的坚果→花生。

examples.en: The grapes on the vine turned purple in September.
examples.zh: 藤上的葡萄九月变紫了。

examples.en: She washed a bunch of grapes for us.
examples.zh: 她给我们洗了一串葡萄。

mnemonic.tip: a bunch of grapes 一串葡萄——葡萄论"串"。

examples.en: The peaches from this tree are really sweet.
examples.zh: 这棵树上的桃子特别甜。

examples.en: She cut a peach into small pieces for the baby.
examples.zh: 她把桃子切成小块给宝宝吃。

mnemonic.tip: peach 和 beach 一字之差——海滩上吃桃子。

examples.en: This pear is so juicy that I need a napkin.
examples.zh: 这个梨汁太多，我得用张餐巾纸。

examples.en: Pears turn soft quickly once they are ripe.

mnemonic.tip: pear 与 pair(一对)同音——买梨常买一对。

examples.en: Do you like pineapple on pizza?
examples.zh: 你喜欢披萨上放菠萝吗？

examples.en: She cut the pineapple into rings.

mnemonic.tip: pine(松树)+apple(苹果)→长得像松果的"苹果"→菠萝。

examples.en: We picked strawberries at the farm last weekend.
examples.zh: 上周末我们去农场摘了草莓。

examples.en: Strawberry ice cream is her favourite.
examples.zh: 草莓冰激凌是她的最爱。

mnemonic.tip: straw(稻草)+berry(浆果)→垫着稻草种的浆果→草莓。

examples.en: The plums are still too sour to eat.
Grandma made plum jam this autumn.
examples.zh: 奶奶今年秋天做了李子酱。

mnemonic.tip: plum 谐音"扑落姆"——熟透的李子扑落一地。

examples.en: Add a slice of lemon to your tea.
Lemons are too sour to eat on their own.

mnemonic.tip: lemon 谐音"柠檬"——又一个音译词。

examples.en: A glass of cold lemonade is perfect on a hot day.
examples.zh: 大热天来杯冰柠檬水最棒了。

examples.en: They sold homemade lemonade at the school fair.
examples.zh: 他们在学校集市上卖自制柠檬水。

mnemonic.tip: lemon(柠檬)+ade(饮料后缀)→柠檬做的饮料。

examples.en: She put a cherry on top of the cake.
examples.zh: 她在蛋糕顶上放了一颗樱桃。

examples.en: Cherries are expensive because they are hard to grow.

mnemonic.tip: cherry 谐音"车厘子"——粤语音译就是樱桃。

examples.en: The mouse ran off with a piece of cheese.
examples.zh: 老鼠叼着一块奶酪跑了。

examples.en: This pizza has three kinds of cheese on it.
examples.zh: 这个披萨上有三种奶酪。

mnemonic.tip: 拍照说 Say cheese!——因为发 cheese 时嘴角上扬像微笑。

examples.en: Spread some butter on the bread while it is warm.
Butter is made from cream.

mnemonic.tip: butterfly(蝴蝶)里藏着 butter——传说蝴蝶爱偷吃黄油。

examples.en: She put fresh cream on the strawberries.
examples.zh: 她在草莓上加了鲜奶油。

examples.en: Would you like cream in your coffee?

mnemonic.tip: ice cream(冰激凌)= 冰+奶油——cream 是冰激凌的灵魂。

examples.en: She has yogurt with fruit for breakfast.
Yogurt is good for your stomach.

mnemonic.tip: yogurt 谐音"优格"——台湾把酸奶叫优格。

examples.en: Bees have been making honey in that tree for years.
examples.zh: 蜜蜂在那棵树里酿蜜很多年了。

examples.en: Add some honey to the tea instead of sugar.

mnemonic.tip: honey 既是蜂蜜也是"亲爱的"——像蜜一样甜的人。

examples.en: Grandma makes strawberry jam every summer.
examples.zh: 奶奶每年夏天做草莓酱。

examples.en: We were stuck in a traffic jam for an hour.
examples.zh: 我们堵车堵了一个小时。

mnemonic.tip: 一词两义：面包上的 jam 果酱，路上的 traffic jam 堵车——都是"挤成一团"。

examples.en: Mix the flour with eggs and milk to make pancakes.
examples.zh: 把面粉和鸡蛋、牛奶混合做薄饼。

examples.en: We need a bag of flour to bake the bread.

mnemonic.tip: flour 与 flower(花)同音——面粉是"粮食之花"。

examples.en: Bread is made from wheat.
The fields of wheat turned gold in June.
examples.zh: 六月的麦田变成了金色。

mnemonic.tip: white(白)少个 h 换个 a——wheat 磨出白面粉。

examples.en: She bought a loaf of bread from the bakery.
examples.zh: 她从面包店买了一条面包。

examples.en: This loaf is still warm from the oven.
examples.zh: 这条面包刚出炉还热着。

mnemonic.tip: 面包论"条"用 loaf：a loaf of bread；复数 loaves。

examples.en: The bakery sells fresh pastries every morning.
examples.zh: 这家面包店每天早上卖新鲜酥点。

examples.en: The pie has a thin pastry on top.
examples.zh: 这个派上面有一层薄酥皮。

mnemonic.tip: paste(面团)+ry→用面团做的点心。

examples.en: Mum baked an apple pie for dessert.
examples.zh: 妈妈烤了苹果派当甜点。

examples.en: The meat pie was still hot when we cut it open.
examples.zh: 肉馅饼切开时还是热的。

mnemonic.tip: apple pie 苹果派——pie 就是"派"的音源。

examples.en: What's for pudding tonight?
Rice pudding is a traditional English dessert.
examples.zh: 米布丁是传统的英式甜点。

mnemonic.tip: pudding 谐音"布丁"——音译词；英式英语里也泛指饭后甜点。

examples.en: She dipped a biscuit in her tea.
examples.zh: 她把饼干在茶里蘸了蘸。

examples.en: The biscuit tin is empty again!

mnemonic.tip: bis+cuit：法语"烤两次"——烤两遍才脆的饼干。

examples.en: He gave her a box of chocolates on her birthday.
examples.zh: 他在她生日时送了一盒巧克力。

examples.en: Hot chocolate warms you up in winter.
examples.zh: 热巧克力在冬天让你暖和起来。

mnemonic.tip: chocolate 谐音"巧克力"——音译词。

examples.en: Leave the dough to rise for an hour.
She rolled the dough flat with a bottle.

mnemonic.tip: doughnut(甜甜圈)= dough(面团)+nut——炸面团圈。

examples.en: The cake needs forty minutes in the oven.
examples.zh: 蛋糕需要在烤箱里烤四十分钟。

examples.en: Be careful, the oven is still hot.

mnemonic.tip: oven 读 /ˈʌvn/——开头不读 o；面包房的心脏。

examples.en: Heat the milk in the microwave for one minute.
examples.zh: 把牛奶放微波炉热一分钟。

examples.en: Microwaves make cooking much quicker.

mnemonic.tip: micro(微小)+wave(波)→用微波加热的炉子。

examples.en: I'll put the kettle on and make some tea.
The kettle whistled when the water boiled.

mnemonic.tip: put the kettle on 是英国人待客第一句——烧水泡茶。

examples.en: Heat the soup in a saucepan over a low fire.
The rice stuck to the bottom of the saucepan.

mnemonic.tip: sauce(酱汁)+pan(锅)→煮酱汁和汤的深口锅。

examples.en: She filled a jug with orange juice.
examples.zh: 她把大罐子装满了橙汁。

examples.en: There is a jug of water on the table.

mnemonic.tip: jug 谐音"揸"——一手揸住罐柄倒水。

examples.en: He wiped his mouth with a napkin.
The waiter folded the napkins into little hats.
examples.zh: 服务员把餐巾折成了小帽子。

mnemonic.tip: nap(小睡)+kin：吃饱擦嘴打个盹——餐巾守着饭桌。

examples.en: Many foreign visitors learn to use chopsticks in China.
examples.zh: 很多外国游客在中国学用筷子。

examples.en: He picked up the noodles with his chopsticks.

mnemonic.tip: chop(快)+sticks(棍)→"快棍"——筷子的英文直译自"筷"。

examples.en: We opened a tin of tomatoes for the sauce.
examples.zh: 我们开了一罐番茄做酱。

examples.en: The biscuits are kept in a tin.

mnemonic.tip: 英式 tin = 美式 can；tinned food 罐头食品。

examples.en: The pasta tastes better with tomato sauce.
Soy sauce is used in almost every Chinese dish.
examples.zh: 几乎每道中国菜都用酱油。

mnemonic.tip: soy sauce 酱油、tomato sauce 番茄酱——sauce 是一切酱汁。

examples.en: Add a little vinegar to the salad.
The chips smell of salt and vinegar.
examples.zh: 薯条闻起来有盐和醋的味道。

mnemonic.tip: 英国人吃薯条要撒 salt and vinegar——酸酸的醋。

examples.en: Add some salt and pepper to the soup.
Red peppers are sweeter than green ones.

mnemonic.tip: salt and pepper 盐和胡椒——西餐桌上的固定搭档。

examples.en: Indian food is famous for its rich spices.
examples.zh: 印度菜以丰富的香料闻名。

examples.en: Cinnamon is a spice used in many desserts.
examples.zh: 肉桂是很多甜点里用的香料。

mnemonic.tip: spicy(辣的)的名词兄弟——spice 是让菜有味道的香料。

examples.en: She grows herbs like mint on her balcony.
examples.zh: 她在阳台上种薄荷之类的香草。

examples.en: The chicken was cooked with garlic and herbs.
examples.zh: 鸡肉是用大蒜和香草烹制的。

mnemonic.tip: herbal tea 草本茶——herb 就是做菜入药的草。

examples.en: Olive oil is widely used in Italian cooking.
examples.zh: 橄榄油在意大利菜里用得很多。

examples.en: He put some olives on the pizza.
examples.zh: 他在披萨上放了些橄榄。

mnemonic.tip: 奥运会的橄榄枝 olive branch 象征和平。

examples.en: Fry the garlic until you can smell it.
Garlic keeps you healthy, but it makes your breath smell.
examples.zh: 大蒜有益健康，但吃了嘴里有味儿。

mnemonic.tip: 传说 garlic 能赶走吸血鬼——味道够冲。

examples.en: The portions at that restaurant are huge.
Could I have a small portion of chips, please?

mnemonic.tip: port(部分)+ion→分出来的一部分→一份。part 同根。

examples.en: He bought a bunch of bananas at the market.
examples.zh: 他在市场买了一串香蕉。

examples.en: She gave her mother a bunch of flowers.

mnemonic.tip: a bunch of：葡萄一串、香蕉一把、鲜花一束——都用 bunch。

examples.en: Pour the cake mixture into the tin.
The drink is a mixture of apple and carrot juice.
examples.zh: 这种饮料是苹果汁和胡萝卜汁的混合。

mnemonic.tip: mix(混合)+ture(名词后缀)→混合物。

collocations: a mixture of A and B

examples.en: The long walk gave us a good appetite.
examples.zh: 走了很远的路，我们胃口大开。

examples.en: He lost his appetite when he was ill.

mnemonic.tip: appe+tite：谐音"啊配太"——菜配得太好，胃口大开。

examples.en: The wedding feast lasted for hours.
examples.zh: 婚宴持续了好几个小时。

examples.en: Spring Festival dinner is a real family feast.
examples.zh: 年夜饭是真正的家庭盛宴。

mnemonic.tip: festival(节日)和 feast(盛宴)同源——过节必有大餐。

examples.en: The hotel serves a breakfast buffet from seven to ten.
examples.zh: 酒店七点到十点供应自助早餐。

examples.en: You can eat as much as you like at the buffet.
examples.zh: 自助餐随便吃，吃多少都行。

mnemonic.tip: buffet 读 /ˈbʊfeɪ/，t 不发音——法语来的"布菲"。

examples.en: We have lunch in the school canteen.
examples.zh: 我们在学校食堂吃午饭。

examples.en: The canteen gets crowded at noon.

mnemonic.tip: canteen 谐音"餐厅"——学校工厂里的食堂。

examples.en: She has baked a birthday cake for her brother.
examples.zh: 她给弟弟烤了一个生日蛋糕。

examples.en: The bread is baked fresh every morning.
examples.zh: 面包每天早上新鲜烤制。

mnemonic.tip: bakery(面包店)就是 bake 的地方——烤面包糕点用 bake。

examples.en: The chicken was roasted with potatoes.
We roasted sweet potatoes over the fire.

mnemonic.tip: roast duck 烤鸭、roast beef 烤牛肉——烤肉用 roast，烤糕点用 bake。

examples.en: Grill the fish for five minutes on each side.
He grilled some corn at the picnic.

mnemonic.tip: grill 是架在火上的铁格子——烤出格子纹的就是 grilled。

examples.en: Chop the onions into small pieces.
He was chopping vegetables when the phone rang.
examples.zh: 电话响的时候他正在切菜。

mnemonic.tip: chopsticks(筷子)的 chop——菜刀哆哆哆剁菜。

examples.en: Peel the apples before you cook them.
She peeled a banana for the baby.

mnemonic.tip: peel 也是果皮本身——banana peel 香蕉皮，踩上会滑倒。

examples.en: Stir the soup so it does not stick.
He stirred some sugar into his coffee.

mnemonic.tip: stir-fry 就是"炒"——边搅边炸。

examples.en: She poured the milk into a glass.
It was pouring with rain outside.

mnemonic.tip: pour 倒水也倒雨——pouring rain 倾盆大雨。

examples.en: Spread the butter thinly on the toast.
examples.zh: 在吐司上薄薄涂一层黄油。

examples.en: The news spread quickly through the school.
examples.zh: 消息很快在学校传开了。

mnemonic.tip: 涂果酱是 spread，消息扩散也是 spread——都是"摊开"。

examples.en: Careful! You are going to spill the juice.
He spilt coffee all over his homework.
examples.zh: 他把咖啡洒了一作业本。

mnemonic.tip: Don't cry over spilt milk——牛奶洒了别哭：覆水难收。

examples.en: You can freeze the soup for up to a month.
examples.zh: 这汤可以冷冻保存一个月。

examples.en: The lake froze over in January.

mnemonic.tip: freezer(冷冻柜)就是 freeze 的地方；过去式 froze。

examples.en: The chocolate melted in the sun.
Melt the butter before adding the flour.
examples.zh: 先把黄油融化再加面粉。

mnemonic.tip: melt 谐音"没了"——冰激凌一晒就"没了"。

examples.en: Chew your food well before you swallow.
The dog was chewing on a bone.

mnemonic.tip: chewing gum 口香糖——就是拿来 chew 的。

examples.en: My throat hurts when I swallow.
He swallowed the medicine with some water.

mnemonic.tip: swallow 也是燕子——燕子囫囵吞食，一口 swallow。

examples.en: She sipped her hot tea slowly.
examples.zh: 她慢慢地小口喝着热茶。

examples.en: He took a sip of the soup to taste it.
examples.zh: 他抿了一小口汤尝尝味道。

mnemonic.tip: sip——"咝"地小小吸一口；drink 大口，sip 小口。

examples.en: Squeeze half a lemon over the fish.
examples.zh: 在鱼上挤半个柠檬的汁。

examples.en: She squeezed some fresh orange juice.

mnemonic.tip: squeeze——"咕吱"一挤，汁就出来了。

examples.en: Mash the potatoes with butter and milk.
examples.zh: 把土豆加黄油和牛奶捣成泥。

examples.en: The baby only eats mashed food.
examples.zh: 这个宝宝只吃捣成泥的食物。

mnemonic.tip: mashed potato 土豆泥——英国国民配菜。

examples.en: The soup is thick and creamy.
I love creamy chocolate ice cream.
examples.zh: 我爱吃奶油味浓的巧克力冰激凌。

mnemonic.tip: cream(奶油)+y(形容词后缀)→像奶油一样的。

examples.en: The chips are golden and crispy.
I like my bacon crispy, not soft.
examples.zh: 我喜欢培根煎得脆脆的，不要软的。

mnemonic.tip: crispy——念起来"咔嚓咔嚓"，就是脆。

examples.en: Fresh apples are lovely and crunchy.
The salad needs something crunchy like nuts.
examples.zh: 沙拉里需要加点脆的东西，比如坚果。

mnemonic.tip: crunch 就是"嘎吱"咬东西的声音——crunchy 嘎吱脆。

examples.en: Fizzy drinks are bad for your teeth.
The lemonade is nice and fizzy.

mnemonic.tip: fizz 是气泡"嘶嘶"声——fizzy drink 汽水。

examples.en: Frozen vegetables are quick to cook.
The pond was frozen all through February.
examples.zh: 池塘整个二月都结着冰。

mnemonic.tip: freeze 的过去分词当形容词——frozen food 冷冻食品。

examples.en: The chips were too greasy to finish.
Greasy food makes me feel sick.

mnemonic.tip: grease 是油脂——greasy 满手是油的感觉。

examples.en: The watermelon is sweet and juicy.
He bit into a juicy peach.
examples.zh: 他咬了一口多汁的桃子。

mnemonic.tip: juice(果汁)+y→果汁满满的。

examples.en: This curry is mild enough for children.
examples.zh: 这个咖喱不辣，孩子也能吃。

examples.en: The weather has been mild this winter.
examples.zh: 今年冬天天气一直很温和。

mnemonic.tip: 辣度阶梯：mild 微辣 → medium 中辣 → hot 重辣。

examples.en: Never eat raw chicken.
Some fish can be eaten raw in Japan.
examples.zh: 在日本有些鱼可以生吃。

mnemonic.tip: raw 谐音"肉啊"——生肉不能吃啊。

examples.en: The bananas are not ripe yet; they are still green.
Pick the tomatoes when they are fully ripe.

mnemonic.tip: rice 大米去 c 加 p——庄稼熟了才有米：ripe 成熟。

examples.en: The apples at the bottom of the box were rotten.
Rotten eggs smell terrible.

mnemonic.tip: rotten 谐音"烂吞"——烂了可不能吞。

examples.en: The soup is too salty for me.
Sea water is salty.

mnemonic.tip: salt(盐)+y→盐味的→咸的。

examples.en: The milk has gone sour.
Lemons taste sour.

mnemonic.tip: sweet and sour pork 糖醋里脊——sour 就是那个"醋"味。

examples.en: The bread has gone stale; use it for the birds.
examples.zh: 面包不新鲜了，拿去喂鸟吧。

examples.en: The air in the room smelled stale.

mnemonic.tip: stale 与 stay 同源——放着不动太久，就不新鲜了。

examples.en: Mum cooked a really tasty dinner tonight.
examples.zh: 妈妈今晚做的饭真好吃。

examples.en: These dumplings are cheap and tasty.

mnemonic.tip: taste(味道)+y→有滋有味的→好吃的。

examples.en: Cook the beef slowly until it is tender.
She gave the baby a tender smile.
examples.zh: 她温柔地对宝宝笑了笑。

mnemonic.tip: 肉嫩是 tender，心软也是 tender——又嫩又温柔。

examples.en: My aunt has been a vegetarian for ten years.
Do you have any vegetarian dishes?

mnemonic.tip: vegetable(蔬菜)+arian(…的人)→只吃蔬菜的人。

examples.en: A vegan eats no meat, eggs or milk at all.
examples.zh: 纯素食者完全不吃肉、蛋、奶。

examples.en: The cafe has a special vegan menu.
examples.zh: 这家咖啡馆有专门的纯素菜单。

mnemonic.tip: vegetarian 的"加强版"——ve-gan 连蛋奶都不沾。

examples.en: Organic vegetables are grown without chemicals.
examples.zh: 有机蔬菜不用化学品种植。

examples.en: Organic food usually costs more.

mnemonic.tip: organ(器官/机体)+ic→顺应自然机体生长的→有机的。

examples.en: Nothing beats homemade dumplings.
examples.zh: 什么都比不上自家包的饺子。

examples.en: She sells homemade cakes at the market.
examples.zh: 她在集市上卖自制蛋糕。

mnemonic.tip: home(家)+made(做的)→家里做的→自制的。

examples.en: She drinks low-fat milk to stay healthy.
examples.zh: 她喝低脂牛奶保持健康。

examples.en: Low-fat yogurt still tastes good.

mnemonic.tip: low(低)+fat(脂肪)→低脂的。

examples.en: Fried food is delicious but fattening.
examples.zh: 油炸食品好吃但容易发胖。

examples.en: Is chocolate really that fattening?
examples.zh: 巧克力真的那么容易让人长胖吗？

mnemonic.tip: fat(胖)+en(使)+ing→让人变胖的。

examples.en: The waiter brought us the menu.
examples.zh: 服务员给我们拿来了菜单。

examples.en: He works as a waiter at weekends.

mnemonic.tip: wait(等候)+er(人)→在旁等候点单的人→服务员。

examples.en: The waitress recommended the fish of the day.
examples.zh: 女服务员推荐了今日鲜鱼。

examples.en: She tipped the waitress five pounds.
examples.zh: 她给了女服务员五英镑小费。

mnemonic.tip: waiter+ess(女性后缀)→女服务员；类似 actress。

examples.en: The shop gives regular customers a discount.
The customer complained that the soup was cold.

mnemonic.tip: custom(习惯)+er→习惯来买东西的人→顾客。

examples.en: Could we have the bill, please?
Dad paid the electricity bill online.

mnemonic.tip: 餐厅结账、水电缴费都是 bill——美式餐厅账单叫 check。

examples.en: They left a tip for the friendly waiter.
examples.zh: 他们给友好的服务员留了小费。

examples.en: The teacher gave us some tips for the exam.
examples.zh: 老师给了我们一些考试小建议。

mnemonic.tip: 一词两义：饭后给的 tip 小费，学习上的 tip 妙招。

examples.en: Let's order a takeaway tonight.
There is a Chinese takeaway near our house.
examples.zh: 我们家附近有家中餐外卖店。

mnemonic.tip: take(拿)+away(走)→拿走吃的→外卖。

examples.en: We are having a barbecue in the garden on Saturday.
examples.zh: 我们周六在花园里办烧烤会。

examples.en: He cooked burgers on the barbecue.

mnemonic.tip: barbecue 的缩写是 BBQ——中文口语里的烧烤聚会。

examples.en: We had a picnic by the lake.
Pack some sandwiches for the picnic.

mnemonic.tip: picnic 谐音"批客逆客"——一批客人逆风也要去野餐。

examples.en: She drank the juice through a straw.
Paper straws are better for the environment.

mnemonic.tip: 最早的吸管就是一根稻草——所以吸管和稻草同词。

examples.en: There is a jar of honey in the cupboard.
She keeps her coins in an old jam jar.
examples.zh: 她把硬币存在旧果酱罐里。

mnemonic.tip: jar 谐音"扎"——玻璃罐碎了会扎手。

examples.en: She had toast and jam for breakfast.
examples.zh: 她早餐吃了烤面包配果酱。

examples.en: Let's drink a toast to the New Year!

mnemonic.tip: 一词两义：早餐的 toast 吐司，宴会上的 toast 祝酒。

examples.en: He has an allergy to peanuts.
Food allergies are becoming more common.

mnemonic.tip: allergy 谐音"爱勒挤"——过敏时喉咙像被勒紧。形容词 allergic。

examples.en: Oranges are rich in vitamin C.
You need vitamins to stay healthy.

mnemonic.tip: vita(生命)+min→维持生命的营养素——"维他命"。

examples.en: Eggs and fish are good sources of protein.
examples.zh: 鸡蛋和鱼是优质蛋白质来源。

examples.en: Athletes need extra protein to build muscle.
examples.zh: 运动员需要额外的蛋白质来长肌肉。

mnemonic.tip: protein 谐音"扑漏提"——健身的人天天提蛋白粉。

examples.en: A can of cola has about 140 calories.
She counts calories when she is on a diet.
examples.zh: 她减肥时会计算卡路里。

mnemonic.tip: calorie 音译"卡路里"——热量单位。

examples.en: Good nutrition is important for growing children.
examples.zh: 良好的营养对成长中的孩子很重要。

examples.en: The label shows the nutrition information.
examples.zh: 标签上有营养成分信息。

mnemonic.tip: nutri(滋养)+tion→营养；nutritious 有营养的。

examples.en: Eating too much junk food is bad for your health.
examples.zh: 吃太多垃圾食品有害健康。

examples.en: He gave up junk food before the sports meeting.
examples.zh: 运动会前他戒掉了垃圾食品。

mnemonic.tip: junk(废品)+food→没营养的"废品"食物。

examples.en: Fast food is quick but not always healthy.
examples.zh: 快餐虽快但不总是健康。

examples.en: They grabbed some fast food after the film.
examples.zh: 看完电影他们随便吃了点快餐。

mnemonic.tip: fast(快)+food→做得快吃得快的餐。

examples.en: This juice contains no artificial flavourings.
examples.zh: 这种果汁不含人工香精。

examples.en: Vanilla is a popular flavouring for ice cream.
examples.zh: 香草是常见的冰激凌调味料。

mnemonic.tip: flavour(味道)+ing→用来添味道的东西。

examples.en: Refreshments will be served after the concert.
The tickets include free refreshments.

mnemonic.tip: re(再)+fresh(清爽)+ments→让人恢复精神的小食——常用复数。

examples.en: Milk, cheese and butter are dairy products.
examples.zh: 牛奶、奶酪和黄油都是乳制品。

examples.en: She avoids dairy because it upsets her stomach.
examples.zh: 她不吃乳制品，因为吃了胃不舒服。

mnemonic.tip: dairy(乳品)与 diary(日记)拼写易混——a-i 顺序不同。

examples.en: The museum has a small cafeteria on the top floor.
examples.zh: 博物馆顶楼有个小自助餐厅。

examples.en: Workers eat lunch in the company cafeteria.
examples.zh: 员工在公司食堂吃午饭。

mnemonic.tip: cafe(咖啡馆)+teria→自取式餐厅。
